feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 September 2026 10:01pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 06 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low to south of Iceland, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Mainly south 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in places at first, veering west 4 or 5 overnight. Backing southwest tomorrow morning, increasing 5 or 6 later in morning or early afternoon, occasionally reaching 7 in places in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at first clearing, then rain spreading from west tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7, veering west or southwest 5 or 6 overnight. Increasing west 6 or 7 on Tuesday morning, veering northwest in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in places later.


##Weather##

Rain at first soon clearing, scattered showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
